name: How long does stair repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does stair repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stair repair depends on the scope of the project. Minor repairs might take a few hours to a day, while more extensive structural repairs could take several days or even longer. We'll provide a time estimate after assessing the damage to your stairs and discussing the repair plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stair repair duration depends on the project's scope, ranging from a few hours to several days.
